meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: 它会从你的 NanoClaw fork 里提取所有定制改动（配置值、源码、人设、技能等），整理成一份可重放的迁移指南；升级时在上游干净代码上按指南重新应用这些改动，取代 git merge，因此不会产生合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你想把定制过的 NanoClaw fork 升级到更新的上游版本、又不想处理 merge 冲突时，或已有迁移指南想重新应用时。

say.text: 把我 NanoClaw 的定制迁移到最新上游版本
say.note: 先提取定制，再生成迁移指南并升级

say.text: 从我的 fork 生成一份迁移指南
用已有的迁移指南升级到上游
say.note: 跳过提取，在干净版本上重放定制

howto.what_en: It extracts your customizations from a NanoClaw fork into a replayable migration guide, then upgrades to upstream by reapplying them on a clean checkout — replacing merge-based upgrades, so there are no merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to upgrade a customized NanoClaw fork to a newer upstream version without merge conflicts, or when you already have a migration guide and want to reapply it.

say_en.text: Migrate my NanoClaw customizations to the latest upstream
Generate a migration guide from my fork
Upgrade using my existing migration guide
say_en.note: Skips extraction, reapplies on a clean base
